title: huberia limae
intro: Huberia limae, commonly known as the 'yellow orchid', is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Huberia limae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
